主要内容: On January 21, 2015, SAP SE, a German multinational software company, filed a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The filing included a press release announcing SAP's preliminary financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2014. The press release highlighted non-IFRS financial measures, which are not prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and are therefore considered non-IFRS financial measures. These measures should be considered in addition to, and not as substitutes for, revenue, operating income, cash flows, or other measures of financial performance prepared in accordance with IFRS. The document also included forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update or revise any forward-looking statements. The filing is part of SAP's ongoing reporting obligations under U.S. securities laws. The provided text is a section of a Form 6-K filing by SAP AG, dated January 21, 2015. This document includes the signatures of the registrant, with Dr. Christoph Huetten and Dr. Christopher Sessar as authorized signatories. The filing is part of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 requirements, indicating that SAP AG has officially submitted this report. The document also references an exhibit index, which includes a press release dated January 20, 2015. This filing is a standard regulatory submission and does not provide detailed financial or operational information beyond the required disclosures.
